title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Ireland excludes crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts
summary: Ireland’s planned investment accounts will offer tax benefits for stocks, bonds and ETFs, while excluding crypto and derivatives as higher-risk products.

title: Webull expands crypto trading into Canada through Coinbase collaboration
summary: The brokerage is adding digital assets alongside stocks, ETFs and options as Canadian crypto ownership rises and regulators move toward clearer industry rules.

title: Bitcoin begins volatile monthly close as US bond yields eye new 20-year high
summary: Bitcoin price action saw sharp moves within its local range as US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent addressed US bond yields.

title: Bitmine now controls 4.9% of Ethereum supply after adding 53.5K ETH
summary: Bitmine has bought Ether for 65 consecutive weeks, maintaining its accumulation strategy through a prolonged crypto downturn and $5.1 billion in paper losses.

title: Strive buys 1,800 Bitcoin for $143M, becomes fifth-biggest corporate holder
summary: Strive’s latest Bitcoin purchase lifted its holdings to 23,156 BTC, making it the fifth-largest publicly traded corporate holder as crypto markets rebound.

title: Russian crypto trading to bring $46B to regulated exchanges in first year after legalization: Report
summary: Regulated cryptocurrency exchanges may see more than $46 billion in crypto trading volume during the first year after legalization, according to estimates from the country’s largest bank.

title: Mystery surrounds why an OG burned $1M in Bitcoin
summary: The million dollar question is what prompted a Bitcoin OG to send 20 BTC to a custodian, retrieve it back, and then deliberately burn it?

title: Japanese regulator requests tax filing exemption for trust-type stablecoins in 2027 reform
summary: Japan’s FSA requested to exempt trust-type stablecoins from mandatory tax filings starting in fiscal year 2027, arguing that it would improve their use as transaction tools.

title: Metaplanet moves 4,800 BTC worth $377M to Coinbase
summary: The Japanese Bitcoin treasury company has transferred 10,270 BTC to Coinbase Prime this week, an amount equal to more than 29% of its reported holdings.
